title: Scenery Editor X
subtitle: User Manual
tagline: Build, edit and preview X-Plane 12 scenery in a real-time 3D editor that draws it the way X-Plane does.
description: The user manual for Scenery Editor X, the 3D scenery editor for X-Plane 12: installing, the workspace, projects, airports, the library, facades, export and reference.
copyright: © 2026 Coalition of Freeware Developers · MIT License
colophon: This manual describes Scenery Editor X, a free, open-source scenery editor for X-Plane 12 made by the Coalition of Freeware Developers.

Part I gets you installed and walks you through your first airport. Part II explains the workspace. Part III covers each kind of scenery work in turn, and Part IV is the reference you come back to: shortcuts, menus, panels, files and fixes.
Scenery Editor X is alpha software. Features change between test builds; where this manual and the editor disagree, the editor is right, and the manual is out of date: please tell us.
X-Plane is a trademark of Laminar Research. Scenery Editor X is not made or endorsed by Laminar Research.
